name: genxormiter
seed: the second positional argument; without it the generator seeds itself from the clock and the instance cannot be reproduced
notes: the miter between two parity circuits over shared inputs: solvable by XOR reasoning, trivially with -s, and still solvable with -r; -l disables the randomisation of the variable order. Beware of the seed: in this version parse_seed assigns instead of accumulating, so only the last digit of a multi-digit seed is used, and 2, 42, 12 and 102 all give the same instance. Use single-digit seeds until it is fixed upstream.
